Which states are home to the most trademark owners' filings?
SELECT own_addr_state_cd AS state, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_addr_state_cd <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a hospital stay for chronic lung disease cost on average in New York in 2016?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_costs AS double)), 0) AS avg_cost FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease%'
Which areas have the highest fair market rent for a two-bedroom apartment?
SELECT areaname, max(try_cast(fmr2 AS double)) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. per capita personal income change from 2000 to 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2000 AS double) AS in_2000, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS in_2024 FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE geofips = '00000' AND linecode = '3'
Which 13F filings list the greatest number of separate holdings?

SELECT c.filingmanager_name, max(try_cast(s.tableentrytotal AS double)) AS holdings FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_summarypage s JOIN govblock_sec.sec_13f_coverpage c ON c.accession_number = s.accession_number GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospitals reported a net loss for fiscal 2023?

SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS hospitals FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND line_num = '02900' AND clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' AND try_cast(itm_val_num AS double) < 0
What were the most common reasons for hospital stays in New York in 2016?
SELECT ccs_diagnosis_description, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem bioassays target the EGFR protein (UniProt P00533)?
SELECT count(DISTINCT aid) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2geneidaccessionuniprot WHERE accession = 'P00533'
Which states received the most federal grant and loan dollars in fiscal year 2022?

SELECT recipient_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many citizens of voting age live in Texas?
SELECT try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE geoname = 'Texas' AND lntitle = 'Total'
Which counties paid the highest average weekly wage in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.avg_wkly_wage AS double) AS weekly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '70' AND q.own_code = '0' AND q.year = '2024' AND q.qtr = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the median gross rent in San Francisco?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US06075' AND variable = 'B25064_E001'
Why do Connecticut consumers complain about insurers most often?
SELECT reason, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ct_insurance_complaints WHERE reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many clinical trials are recruiting patients right now?
SELECT count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status = 'RECRUITING'
In which counties do the most adults report depression?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'DEPRESSION' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much sulfur dioxide did the Benning Generation Station emit in 2008?
SELECT sum(so2_mass_lbs) AS so2_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE facility_name = 'Benning Generation Station' AND year(date) = 2008
Which companies earned the highest net income in their 2021 annual reports?

SELECT s.name, max(n.value) AS net_income FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_num n JOIN govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE n.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND cast(n.qtrs AS varchar) = '4' AND s.form = '10-K' AND cast(s.fy AS varchar) = '2021' AND n.uom = 'USD' AND (n.segments IS NULL OR n.segments = '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many presidential votes were cast in Miami-Dade County in 2020?
SELECT max(try_cast(totalvotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_county_president_returns WHERE year = '2020' AND state_po = 'FL' AND county_name = 'MIAMI-DADE'
Which coal mines shipped the most fuel to power plants?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT coalmine_name, coalmine_state, sum(try_cast(quantity AS double)) AS tons FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Coal' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the IRS refund to individual taxpayers over fiscal 2019?
SELECT max(try_cast(tax_refund_fytd_amt AS double)) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.income_tax_refunds_issued WHERE record_date = '2019-09-30' AND tax_refund_type LIKE '%Individual%'
At which colleges do graduates leave with the highest median debt?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(grad_debt_mdn AS double) AS median_debt FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Did more workers quit their jobs in 2021 than in 2019?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(value AS double)) AS quits_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000QUL' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') AND period <> 'M13' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which medical schools trained the most clinicians enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT med_sch, count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were there more road deaths in 2019, before the pandemic, or in 2021?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which New York zones had the highest average real-time power price in 2023?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone

SELECT name, avg(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of formal Clean Air Act enforcement actions are taken by EPA itself?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN state_epa_flag = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_air_formal_actions
What types of patent application are filed most, regular, provisional, reissue or reexamination?
SELECT application_type, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dermatologists are enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE pri_spec = 'DERMATOLOGY'
Which power plants still run the oldest generators?
SELECT plant_name, state, min(try_cast(operating_year AS integer)) AS oldest_unit FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE status = 'OP' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
What share of patent applications come from small and micro entities rather than large ones?

SELECT entity_type, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE entity_type <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of underground natural gas storage are most common?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_storage_facilities WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many deposited substance records point to aspirin?
SELECT count(*) AS substances FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_sid WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which section 527 political organisations reported spending the most?
SELECT column03 AS organisation, round(sum(try_cast(column13 AS double))) AS spent FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did onshore or offshore wind units produce more electricity in the European unit data?
Wind Entsoe Wind Units Entsoe Generation Wind Units
SELECT productiontypename, round(sum(try_cast(actualgenerationoutput AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.wind_entsoe_wind_units_entsoe_generation_wind_units GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which chemical formulas appear most often in ChEBI?
SELECT formula, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_chemical_data WHERE formula IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications were filed in each of the last ten years?
SELECT substr(cast(filing_dt AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE filing_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Puerto Rico municipalities have the most mapped buildings in the PR100 study?
SELECT addrcity, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_pr100_setbacks_buildings WHERE addrcity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How is ethanol written as a SMILES string?
SELECT c1 AS smiles FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_smiles WHERE c0 = '702'
Which New York counties drew the most federal assistance in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT recipient_county_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of 2023 mortgage applications were to buy a home, refinance or borrow against equity?

SELECT CASE cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) WHEN '1' THEN 'home purchase' WHEN '2' THEN 'home improvement' WHEN '4' THEN 'other purpose' WHEN '31' THEN 'refinancing' WHEN '32' THEN 'cash-out refinancing' ELSE 'not applicable' END AS purpose, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which NIH institutes are most often credited with funding published inventions?

SELECT level_three AS institute, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_two = 'National Institutes of Health' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are hazardous waste generators split between large, small and very small quantity?
SELECT hreport_universe_record, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the most hospitals enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
